title: 民生与社会发展词汇
goal: 辨认民生与社会发展词汇，准确表达公共服务对象。

points.label: 辨认民生与社会发展词汇
选择准确表达公共服务对象的词语

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 说明公共服务时，要分清三件事：谁提供服务，为谁提供，用什么方式提供。provide ... for 引出服务对象。服务带来的改善，只译原文写到的。

body.box:
社区中心为老年居民提供送餐服务。志愿者将餐食送到他们家中。
The community center provides meal delivery for older residents. Volunteers bring meals to their homes.

body.p: older residents 是服务对象，volunteers 是送餐的人。服务对象只是老年居民，不是全体居民。

body.box:
社区中心为行动不便的老年居民安排家访。工作人员在家访中介绍医疗预约方式，并帮助有需要的居民联系诊所。该服务减少了部分居民到中心咨询的次数。
A community center arranges home visits for older residents with limited mobility. During the visits, staff explain how to make medical appointments and help residents who need assistance contact a clinic. The service has reduced the number of trips some residents make to the center for advice.

body.p: older residents with limited mobility 是服务对象，home visits 是服务方式。到中心咨询的次数减少，是原文给出的结果。

body.box:
Who receives the home visits?
1. Staff of the community center
2. Older residents with limited mobility
3. All older residents of the community
4. Clinic staff who make appointments

body.p: 原文写 arranges home visits for older residents with limited mobility，接受家访的是行动不便的老年居民，即第二项。第三项漏掉了 with limited mobility 这一限定。

groups.fill: A village runs a service for older residents. The comm{unity} center recruits volun{teers} to deliver me{als} to resi{dents} who have limited mobi{lity}. Each volu{nteer} visits a ho{me} where a resident lives on an assigned ro{ute}. The off{ice} records each deli{very} so that staff know which meals have arrived. The volunteers report any delivery problem to the center. The service does not replace medical treatment, and its records concern meal delivery rather than the health of every resident.
notes: meals：后文 which meals have arrived 再次提到餐食。
route：assigned route 指分配的路线。
delivery：送达记录使工作人员确认餐食送达。

groups.text:
A Village Service

A village clinic sends a nurse to a school once a month. The nurse offers health checks to students whose families have agreed. Teachers arrange the visits, but they do not perform the checks. The clinic reports fewer journeys to the clinic for participating students.

options: A nurse sent by the clinic
The teachers who arrange visits
The families who gave consent
The students at the school
items.why: A village clinic sends a nurse 和 The nurse offers health checks 说明做检查的是诊所派来的护士。教师只安排探访，原文写明 they do not perform the checks。

options: Every student at the village school
Students with their families' agreement
Teachers who arrange the nurse's visits
Parents who agreed to the health checks
items.why: 原文 offers health checks to students whose families have agreed，接受检查的是家人同意了的学生，即第二项。第一项把范围扩大到了全校学生。

options: Perform the health checks
Put things in a neat order
Plan and organize the visits
Agree to the checks for their children
items.why: Teachers arrange the visits 说的是教师安排护士的探访，arrange 在这里是安排、组织。后半句 they do not perform the checks 说明检查不由教师做。

options: They received checks from their teachers.
They all stopped going to the clinic.
Their families visited the school less often.
They traveled to the clinic less often.
items.why: 末句 reports fewer journeys to the clinic for participating students，参加的学生去诊所的次数少了，即第四项。第二项把次数减少说成了完全不去。

options: A school where teachers arrange visits
A place that provides medical care
A monthly visit made by a nurse
A health check offered to students
items.why: village clinic sends a nurse 和后面的 health checks 说明 clinic 是提供医疗服务的地方，即第二项。第三项说的是诊所派护士这件事，不是诊所本身。

groups.fill: A town opened a center for job seekers. The off{ice} offers trai{ning} to local wor{kers} seeking emplo{yment}. A st{aff} member meets each parti{cipant} and discusses suitable cou{rses}. Local empl{oyers} also give information about job vaca{ncies}, while volun{teers} help organize meetings. These activities provide information and training; the center does not promise a job to every participant. The service is available to residents who register with the center before attending its courses.

groups.text:
A Mobile Community Service

Several villages lie far from the nearest town library. A library team now visits these villages in a vehicle carrying books. The service is intended for residents who have difficulty traveling to the town. At each stop, residents can borrow books and return them during a later visit. The team follows a published schedule, so the villages receive visits on different days.

The team also works with volunteers who help residents find books. The volunteers do not decide which villages the vehicle visits. That responsibility belongs to the library team, which plans the route with village representatives. A separate school reading program is organized by teachers and uses books kept at the school.

A report on the mobile service records that some residents made fewer journeys to the town library after the visits began. It does not say that everyone stopped traveling to town or that all residents borrowed books. The reported change concerns the travel of some users, while the service itself is offered to residents who have difficulty making that journey.

中文信息：流动图书服务为难以前往镇图书馆的村民提供借还书服务。图书馆团队安排路线，志愿者帮助查找书籍。报告称部分居民到镇图书馆的次数减少。

items.stem: Who is the mobile service intended for?
options: Teachers who organize the school reading program
Residents who find the town hard to reach
All residents of the distant villages
Volunteers who help residents find books
items.why: 原文 The service is intended for residents who have difficulty traveling to the town，服务对象是难以去镇上的村民，即第二项。第三项把对象扩大到了全体村民。

options: The school reading teachers
The residents who borrow books during the mobile service visits
The library team with village representatives
The volunteers helping readers
items.why: library team ... plans the route with village representatives 指明安排者。

options: Take books away and return them later
Receive books to keep at home for good
Look for books with help from volunteers
Bring back books on a later visit
items.why: 原文 borrow books and return them during a later visit，先把书拿走，下次再还，即第一项。第四项只说了还书这一半。

items.stem: What does the report say changed?
options: Every resident stopped making journeys to the town library.
All residents borrowed books from the vehicle.
Some residents made more journeys to the town library.
Some residents traveled to the town library less often.
items.why: 报告写 some residents made fewer journeys to the town library，范围是部分居民，变化是次数减少，即第四项。原文明确说报告 does not say that everyone stopped traveling to town。

items.stem: What does mobile describe in this service?
options: A school program staying in one place
A library service traveling between villages
A permanent collection at each school
A town library open on different days
items.why: visits these villages in a vehicle carrying books 说明服务在村庄间流动。
